full_judgment:
Respondent No. 2 i.e. Janata Bank (shortly, the Bank), as plaintiff filed Artha Rin Suit No.125 of 2003 before the Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Chittagong (shortly, the Adalat) impleading the petitioner and others as defendants of the suit. The suit was subsequently renumbered as Artha Rin Suit No.116 of 2004. The suit was decreed in favour of the Bank and the judgment-debtors having failed to pay the decretal amount the decree-holder Bank filed Artha Rin Execution Case No.464 of 2004 on 8-8-2004 before the Adalat. On 19-3-2005 the decree-holder Bank filed an application for issuance of warrant of arrest against the judgment debtor petitioner under section 34 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 (the Ain) whereupon the Adalat passed the impugned order issuing warrant of arrest against the judgment- debtors. 

 "From a combined reading of those sub- sections of section 34 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 it manifests that the Adalat is empowered to pass an order of warrant of arrest/civil imprisonment directly on the basis of an application filed by the decree-holder bank when no auction sale is possible to be held for any reason."
